reasons: ATAP (CP3880) is planned for Y4S1 (Sem 7), which is the last semester used. Rule 10 requires ATAP to be in a semester before the last one used, so another course must be planned in a later semester (Sem 8). However, all required courses (CS3219, CS2109S, CS2105, CS4231, CS2106, CS4226) are scheduled in Sem 6 or earlier to satisfy prerequisites and the 'graduate as early as possible' goal, leaving no room for a course in Sem 8. Specifically, CS4231 requires CS3210 or CS3230, neither of which is in the 'must take' list nor completed, making CS4231 impossible to plan without adding unplanned courses which is not allowed unless they are prerequisites for planned courses. Even if we assume CS3210/CS3230 are completed (not stated), CS4226 requires CS2105 and an EE/MA course. The student has not completed any EE/MA courses listed in CS4226's prerequisite (EE2012A, EE2012, ST2334, EE3204). The student has completed ST2334, so CS4226 is eligible. But CS4231 requires CS3210 or CS3230. Neither is completed nor in the must-take list. Thus CS4231 cannot be taken. Therefore, no valid plan exists.
